eg6acta91vfmupevylb.resumeText:
Rohan Mehta
Backend Developer | rohan.mehta@example.com | +91 91111 67890 | Bengaluru, India |
github.com/rohanmehta
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend Developer with 4 years of experience designing REST APIs and scalable server-side services. Strong in
Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and distributed application fundamentals, with practical experience in authentication,
caching, background jobs, and cloud deployment.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Python, JavaScript, SQL
Frameworks & Tools: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Django
Other: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, AWS, REST APIs, JWT, Git, CI/CD
EXPERIENCE
CloudRoute Systems — Backend Developer | 2022–Present
• Designed and maintained Python and Node.js REST APIs supporting web and mobile clients.
• Built PostgreSQL data models and optimized queries for high-volume transactional workflows.
• Implemented JWT authentication, role-based authorization, Redis caching, and background processing.
• Containerized services with Docker and supported deployments on AWS using CI/CD pipelines.
DataNest Labs — Software Engineer | 2021–2022
• Developed Express.js APIs for internal analytics and customer management systems.
• Integrated third-party APIs and implemented validation, logging, and structured error handling.
• Wrote automated unit and integration tests for core backend services.
PROJECTS
Order Processing API
FastAPI and PostgreSQL service handling order creation, validation, status transitions, and asynchronous notification jobs. Added
Redis caching and API authentication.
Real-Time Notification Service
Node.js service using WebSockets and Redis pub/sub to deliver real-time application notifications to connected clients.
EDUCATION
B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering — Visvesvaraya Technological University, 2021
